svg.text: BanditLab | learn before committing to the higher-mean arm
Independent latent rates: arm 0 ~ Beta(1,1), arm 1 ~ Beta(5,4). Exact prior expectations.
Expected total unit rewards over the SAME pull budget
Budget (pulls). Lines connect the six evaluated budgets, plus zero.
At one pull, arm 1 is optimal. At two pulls, BOTH first arms tie and the adaptive-greedy gain is zero.
Greedy updates its posterior after every reward. The upper bound knows rates, not future reward draws.
Fixed independent Beta-Bernoulli model only. Not empirical trials, frequentist regret or a universal greedy ranking.
